title: Register or notify the food business
what: Notify, register or license the food business with the enforcement agency (usually the local council) before trading, and meet the Food Standards Code.

sources.title: Food Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a food business unless the food business is registered under this Part.

reach.note: Calibration: coded for the calibration classes; every class that handles food for sale follows in phase D.
